rules.text: A change to headings 2101 through 2102 from any other chapter.
A change to subheading 2103.10 from any other chapter.
A change to subheading 2103.20 from any other chapter, provided that tomato ketchup of subheading 2103.20 does not contain nonoriginating goods from subheading 2002.90.
A change to subheading 2103.30 from any other chapter.
A change to subheading 2103.90 from any other heading.
A change to heading 2104 from any other heading.
A change to heading 2105 from any other heading, except from chapter 4 or from dairy preparations containing over 10 percent by weight of milk solids of subheading 1901.90.

A change to concentrated juice of any single fruit or vegetable fortified with vitamins or minerals of subheading 2106.90 from any other chapter, except from headings 0805 or 2009 or subheading 2202.90.
